notes.title: Little Update
notes.notes:
On a chilly December evening in 1925, the stage is set...

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257290/ce89dbde60ccc5f345f58c74dd32b18c31e74c84.jpg"]

It's been a year since I started working on Verismo with my complete focus. There's been plenty of breaks and empty days but just as many intense weeks of focus.



I can't believe it's been almost 6 months since I uploaded the demo. Time is flying fast.



Before I disappear into the void again I wanted to share how my babies have changed over the year.



The main cast in June 2024 (the first time I drew any of them. I had no clue what style to go for)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257290/fb76bc9c6837f0777e483dc6edeefeed86c4197f.jpg"]

The main cast today. Looking spiffy.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257290/9e4ecfc90e949f0557b2260920d3fd78ae3c43b2.jpg"]



I've been mulling over my progress since I uploaded the demo in January. I've decided to think of that demo as my first "game", the final demo as the second game, and the release as my third. I feel a little more accomplishment having finished the first step of this journey.



My goal is to finish this next demo by the end of the year. There is a ton of art to do up-front, but because it all takes place in one town, it'll cut back on the art I have to do later, hopefully.



Anyway.



A dopo.

notes.title: Demo Release Update + 2025 Wishes
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257290/e6ca8b00e449dbe9f94cb29f03a5ee5488476f13.png
Ciao everyone! I wanted to throw a little update here on Verismo's demo progress.

When's the Prologue demo coming out?

I still have a handful of sprites to draw and a couple cutscenes to refine, but after that I’m ready to release the demo. It’ll come out sometime in January, and first on itch.io. If I need to refine the build (as it’s my first game release ever), I’ll do that then launch it here on Steam shortly after.

It's about 15 minutes long, maybe a little longer if you want to interact with everything.

What’s next after this demo?

If all goes well, I’ll move forward with the full demo. It’ll have around an hour of playtime I’m guessing. And that demo will go to Steam Next Fest. Not sure which one I’ll make it to yet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45257290/1fe12b198338c7e8a736d9118636249d3fbca0e9.png
Part of a cutscene in which nothing goes wrong and nobody dies!

What about the full release?

No set date yet. But I’ve learned a lot from making this initial demo, and I think I can work even smarter going forward. I’m desperate not to let this project drag out.

I’m going to rest for a little while before finishing up, but I hope you enter 2025 with a sense of optimism, because no matter the year you had before, at least there’s always a new one ahead.
